tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// skye bo dam pa rnams la spring ba'i yi ge bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// brtse bas legs pa'i lam la sbyor// mkhas pa'i phyir na bden pa ston// mu stegs gzhan gyis mi bsgul ba'i// ston mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dam pa yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mngon sum gyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams bdag gi dpang du gyur pa lags/ gzhan yang deng sang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos smra ba rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la lhag pa'i bsam pa dag pas mos pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la don 'di zhu ba/ bdag gis rgya gar dang bod la yongs su grags pa'i sde snod gsum dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi lung dang rigs pa dang*/ gdams gang dang*/ rjes su gdams pa phal mo che thos shing 'dris par bgyis/ de la bdag gis bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa 'di ltar go bas/ 'thad mi 'thad legs par dpyad par zhu/ thog mar skyabs 'gro ma byas na/ sangs rgyas pa'i khongs su mi chud/ sems bskyed ma byas na/ theg pa chen po'i khongs su mi chud/ dbang bskur ma byas na gsang sngags pa'i khongs su mi chud par go 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ gang dag dge slong gi sdom pa ma thob pa de dag la dge slong gi ming mi gnas/ byang chub mchog tu sems ma bskyed pa de dag la byang chub sems dpa'i ming mi gnas/ gang dag dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba ma byas pa de dag la gsang sngags pa'i ming mi gnas/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so// des na chos kyi gzhi skyabs 'gro yin/ de yang thun mong gi skyabs 'gro la brten nas so sor thar pa'i sdom pa skye/ de lam gyi bden pas sbyangs na srid pa gsum na dgra bcom par 'gyur/ rang sangs rgyas kyang gzhi de la brten nas skyabs 'gro dang thabs kyi cha cung zad yod do// thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro la brten nas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa skye/

sdom pa 'di sems bskyed kyi skabs su thob/ de lam pha rol phyin pa drug gis sbyangs nas bskal pa grangs med gsum na 'tshang rgya/ 'di yang byang chub sems dpa' dbang po rno rtul gyi bye brag mang du mthong*/ bla na med pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed la brten nas/ rig pa 'dzin pa gsang sngags kyi sdom pa skye/ de dbang bskur gyi dus su thob kyi/ gzhan du thob par gsungs pa ma mthong*/ dbang bskur gyi sdom pa lam rim pa gnyis kyis sbyangs na ye shes phyag rgya chen po rtogs te/ rab tshe 'di la 'tshang rgya/ 'bring 'chi ka'am bar dor/ tha ma skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad na 'tshang rgya bar gsungs/ des na/ dbang bskur mchog thob rdo rje yi// slob dpon la ni de bzhin gshegs// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pas// dus gsum du ni mngon phyag 'tshal// zhes bya ba dang*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dbang bskur thob pa'i slob dpon la ji ltar blta bar bya/ zhes bya ba'i lan du dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig la mchod pa bsod nams mnyam par gsungs/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba las kyang*/ gang la dbang rab mchog thob pa// de ni bla mar yongs su gzung*// zhes bya ba dang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las kyang*/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med// bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so// 'di'i lung dang rigs pa rnams yi ge mangs kyis 'jigs nas 'dir ma bris so// des na sdom pa gsum gyi babs 'di ltar 'thad mi 'thad ngas bshad pa dang*/ mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa mthun mi mthun legs par dpyad par zhu/ bye brag tu so sor thar pa la yang nyan thos dang theg chen gnyis/ nyan thos la rtsa ba'i sde bzhi/ saṃ skṛ ta dang*/ pra kṛ ta dang*/ a ba bhraṃ sha dang*/ pi shā tsi ka zhes bya ba skad rigs bzhi gsungs/ de las gyes pa'i sde pa bco brgyad snang*/

de dag la gnang bkag mi 'dra ba du ma mthong*/ de dag gis dang por len tshul dang*/ bar du bsrung tshul dang*/ gnang bkag gi dbye ba dang*/ tha mar gtong tshul dang*/ phyir bcos pa'i thabs rnams so so'i gzhung dang mthun par bya dgos kyi/ phan tshun bsrer mi rung zhes bdag gis bshad/ bod du thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba min pa ma bsgyur/ lugs 'di 'thad mi 'thad/ sde pa tha dad klog pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ 'dul ba 'od ldan dang*/ spyod 'jug gi shes rab le'u dang*/ rnam bshad rigs pa dang*/ rtog ge 'bar ba la sogs pa nas gsungs pa dang*/ ngas bshad pa dang mthun mi mthun dpyad par zhu/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la/ don dam sems bskyed bsgoms pa las skye bar gsungs kyi/ cho ga las skye bar gsungs pa bdag gis ma mthong*/ kun rdzob sems bskyed cho ga las skye bar gsungs/ de la'ang nyan thos kyi lugs te/ theg pa chen po ba mi 'dod/ theg pa chen po ba la'ang sems tsam pa dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs gnyis snang*/ sems tsam pa'i lugs de/ slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyi bzhed pa/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i lugs/ da lta bka' gdams pas mdzad pa de yin/ de la so sor thar pa rigs bdun gang rung rten du dgos la sde snod kyi ma mo rnams shes dgos/ de dang mi ldan pa la sems bskyed bya bar ma gsungs/ dbu ma pa'i sems bskyed 'di/ 'phags pa klu sgrub gyi lugs dang*/ spyod 'jug nas 'byung ba chos rjes skya pa yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i lugs de lags/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la so sor thar pa rigs bdun rten du mi dgos/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi ma mo mi shes kyang sems bskyed skye/ 'di dag gi cho ga dang*/ bslab bya'i khyad par rnams byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang*/ sdom pa nyi shu pa dang*/ bslab btus dang*/ spyod 'jug tu gsal/ nged zer ba dang*/ gzhung du ma nas bshad pa mthun mi mthun dpyad par zhu/

gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur la/ rgyud sde bzhi la dbang bskur kyi babs mi 'dra ba bzhi snang*/ nang gses kyi dbye ba/ dgyes rdor bde mchog la sogs tha dad pa cung zad mthong*/ spyir slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs gcig tu bsres nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du mi 'bral ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig shes na/ dbang bskur phyin ci ma log pa thob par 'gyur/ de lta bu'i cho ga mi shes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ chos sgo dang*/ gtor dbang la sogs pa smin byed kyi dbang bskur du bshad pa rgyud sde gang du yang ma mthong*/ bod kyis byas pa'i rgyud la yid brtan med/ nged zer ba dang sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i rgyud gnyis mthun mi mthun dpyad par zhu/ rgya nag mkhan po na re/ 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu rang ngo rang gis ma shes pas lan/ rang ngo rang gis shes na 'tshang rgya/ de'i phyir sems ngo 'phrod na dkar po chig thub yin/ 'di yi gzhung 'dzugs pa la sems ngo 'phrod pa na nyal bas chog zer nas/ bsam gtan nyal ba'i 'khor lo/ de'i gnad ston pa bsam gtan gyi lon/ de'i gags sel ba la bsam gtan gyi yang lon/ de'i gdams ngag rigs pas sgrub pa la lta ba'i rgyab sha de lung gis sgrub pa la mdo sde brgyad cu khungs zhes bya ba bstan bcos lnga byas/ de'i lugs kyis chos la yang yas 'bab dang mas 'dzeg ces bya ba/ cig car pa dang*/ rim gyis pa'i lugs gnyis yod pa las/ nged kyi 'di khyung nam mkha' las bab pa dang 'dra/ cig car ba yin zer ro// de dag slob dpon ka ma la shī las sun phyung nas/ dbu ma bsgom rim gsum dang*/ dbu ma snang ba la sogs pa bstan bcos chen po mdzad do// de nas rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis/ kho'i chos lugs rnams gter du sbas nas/ da slan chad bod kyi rgyal khams su dkar po chig thub su byed la chad pa yod do zhes khrims bcas/

'di dag gi lo rgyus rnams/ rgyal bzhed/ dpa' bzhed/ 'bangs bzhed rnams mthun par snang*/ bdag gis kyang*/ slob dpon ka ma la shī la'i rjes su 'brangs nas bshad/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa'ang 'di yin par mthong*/ dkar po chig thub la shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa mi srid/ gsang sngags sam pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis thabs sna tshogs la mkhas pa'i stong pa nyid go bas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid grub par go /de'ang spyod 'jug las/ sna tshogs rkyen las byung ba yi// sgyu ma de yang sna tshogs nyid// rkyen gcig gis ni kun nus pa// gang na yang ni yod ma yin// zhes bya ba dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ rnam pa du mar thabs mang po// yun ring dus su goms pa las// de las skyon dang yon tan dag /rab tu gsal ba nyid du 'gyur// zhes bya ba la sogs pa du ma dang*/ brtse ldan sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod pas// thabs rnams la ni mngon sbyor mdzad// thabs byung de ni lkog gyur pa// de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ ji ltar mdud pa'i bye brag gis// gos la tshon bkra mi bkra ba// de bzhin 'phen pa'i dbang gis na// grol ba'i ye shes bkra mi bkra// zhes bya ba dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ thabs dang mi ldan ye shes dang*// bslab pa dag kyang gsungs pa ni// dpa' bo chen pos nyan thos rnams// de la gzhug pa'i phyir bshad do// gang dag dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams// thabs dang shes rab ldan pa la// bslabs nas bla med theg pa ni// 'dus ma byas pa de 'thob bo// zhes gsungs la/ de bzhin du mdo sde dang rgyud sde/ bstan bcos chen po thams cad las kyang*/ thabs dang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa ma gtogs pa/ dkar po chig thub kyis 'tshang rgya bar ma gsungs/ mdo rgyud las phyag gam bskor ba tsam dang*/ me tog re phul ba'am/ gzungs re bton pa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan tsam brjod pa'am/ mos gus re byas pa'am/

snying rje re skyes pa'am/ stong nyid go ba tsam gyis 'tshang rgya bar gsungs pa yod mod kyi/ de dag ni dgongs pa dang*/ ldem dgongs su shes par bya'i/ sgra drang po ma yin te/ mgon po byams pas/ don sgra ji bzhin yongs rtogs na// bdag nyid bsnyems shing blo nyams 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// dper na rgyu spun ma 'tshogs na za 'og gi ri mo mi 'byung la/ sa bon dang chu lud ma 'tshogs na/ zhing gi ston thog mi 'byung*/ rten 'brel thams cad ma 'tshogs na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'byung bar go /spyir sems ngo 'phrod pa dgos mod/ 'on kyang bzang ngan gnyis su snang*/ thabs kyis yon tan rdzogs nas sems ngo 'phrod na 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur la/ thabs kyis yon tan ma rdzogs par sems ngo 'phrod pa la ji ltar bzang yang*/ nyan thos kyi dgra bcom/ 'bring gzugs med kyi khams/ tha ma ngan song du skye bar gsungs/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa nyid la blta nyes na// shes rab chung ba rnams phung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa yang de la dgongs/ de bzhin du zhing las snye ma 'ong dgos kyang*/ 'ong lugs bzang ngan gnyis yod/ sdong bu rdzogs nas snye ma byung na lo legs 'byung*/ ma rdzogs par snye ma byung na lo nyes 'gro/ de bzhin du sems ngo 'phrod pa'ang*/ dus tshod la 'phrod pas chog dus ma yin par 'phrod pa la grogs med/ 'di dag la dgongs nas/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las/ blo sbyang ma byas sems can la// stong pa nyid ni sgrogs pa dang*// zhes blo ma sbyangs pa la stong pa nyid bshad pa la rtsa ltung 'byung na/ stong nyid go na smos ci dgos/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ shā ri'i bus chos bshad na dgra bcom lnga brgyar 'gro ba zhig 'jam dpal gyis chos gsungs pas/ dmyal ba pa lnga brgyar skyes pa'ang*/ yon tan ma rdzogs par sems ngo 'phrod pa dgag pa'i phyir gsungs pa yin/ des na rgyud las rim gyis pa dang*/

cig car ba gnyis gsungs pa ni/ bsnyen gnas la sogs pa'i sdom pa dang*/ nyan thos/ sems tsam/ dbu ma'i lta ba la rim gyis sbyangs nas/ phyis dbang bskur bya ste/ lam rim gnyis la slob na/ rim gyis pa zhes bya la/ dang po nyid du gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur te/ rim pa gnyis la slob pa la cig car ba zhes zer te/ deng sang grags pa'i rim gyis pa dang*/ cig car pa de lta bu mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa ma mthong*/ yang dang po lta ba bstan nas/ phyis spyod pa la rim gyis sbyor ba/ dang po spyod pa la rim gyis sbyangs nas/ phyis lta ba ston pa'i bkri lugs gnyis snang ste/ 'di gnyis blo'i bye brag gis lam rim mi 'dra ba yin gyis/ 'di dag la rim gyis pa dang*/ cig car ba bshad pa ma mthong*/ spyir nged kyi bla ma chos rje sa skya pa chen po'i zhal nas/ bshad pa dang lag len gang byed kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mthun na sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// mi mthun bstan par mi 'gyur zhes gsungs/ nged kyis kyang de'i gsung bzhin 'bad nas bsgrub pa'i don lags/ lugs 'di 'thad mi 'thad rnam par dpyad par zhu/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo rgyud thams cad las/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid yod med kyi spros pa dang bral par gsungs/ de'ang mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ mya ngan 'das pa'i chos la chos med de// gang phyir de yod nam yang yod ma yin// rtog bcas dag gi yod dang med ces bstan// de ltar brtags pas sdug bsngal zhi ma'i 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ yod dang med ces bya ba mtha' yin te// gtsang dang mi gtsang 'di yang mtha' yin no// de ltar mtha' gnyis rnam par spang bya ste// mkhas pas dbus la'ang gnas par mi bya'o// zhes bya ba dang*/ yod dang med ces bya ba rtsod pa ste// gtsang dang mi gtsang 'di yang rtsod pa yin// rtsod par 'gyur pas sdug bsngal zhi mi 'gyur// rtsod pa med par gyur na sdug bsngal zhi// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so// slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/

yod ces bya ba rtag par 'dzin// med ces bya ba chad par lta// des na yod dang med pa la// mkhas pas gnas par mi bya'o// zhes bya ba dang*/ gnas med chos 'dis skrag gyur pas// skye bo gnas la mngon dga' zhing*// yod dang med las ma 'das pas// mi mkhas rnams ni phung bar 'gyur// zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so// gzhan yang*/ yod med 'dzin pa las grol na// sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa'i mdo rgyud thams cad dang*/ bstan bcos chen po thams cad las/ yod med du 'dzin pa thams cad dgag par mthong*/ des na nged kyis kyang 'chad pa'i tshe na yang*/ yod med las 'das par bshad/ bsgom pa'i tshe yang yod med las 'das par bsgom/ bsngo ba'i tshe na yang yod med las 'das par bsngo ba bgyis/ lugs 'di sde snod dang mthun mi mthun dpyad par zhu/ chos kyi dbyings kyang dge sdig las grol bar gsungs/ de'ang slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ shes pas yod dang med zhi'i phyir// sdig dang bsod nams las 'das pa// de yis bde 'gro ngan 'gro las// de ni thar pa dam par bshad// ces bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so// 'bum las kyang*/ chos kyi dbyings la yongs su bsngo ba med do// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'ang*/ lang kar gshegs pa dang*/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma dang*/ dbu ma la 'jug pa la sogs pa mdo bstan bcos las drang don la gsungs par mthong*/ nga zer ba dang mdo bstan bcos thams cad las gsungs pa gnyis mthun mi mthun dpyad par zhu/ gzhan yang nged kyis bshad pa'i lung dang rigs pa rnams dang*/ bod gzhan zer ba'i lung rigs mi 'dra ba mang du snang ba 'di'ang gang bden dpyad par zhu/ man ngag la'ang*/ dbang bzhi man ngag gi gnad dang*/ lam rim pa gnyis kyi gnad dang*/ ye shes phyag rgya chen po'i gnad la'ang*/

nga zer ba dang gzhan 'dod pa gnyis mi 'dra ba du ma snang*/ sa dang lam gyi rnam gzhag la yang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis kyi lam lnga dang*/ sa bcu'i bgrod lugs mi 'dra ba dang*/ phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel gyi rnam gzhag mi 'dra ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la yang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par la'ang*/ nged 'dod pa dang gzhan zer ba gnyis mi 'dra ba'i khyad par du ma gda' bas/ 'di dag tshig dang don gyi rnam dbye shes pa/ lung dang rigs pa'i gnad la mkhas pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi don la ma rmongs pa/ gzhung dang gdams ngag gi gnad mi 'gal bar nyams su len pa shes pa/ drang don dang nges don gyis mdo'i cha phyed pa/ dgongs pa dang ldem dgongs kyi gnad ma 'khrul bar thugs su chud pa/ sgra ji bzhin pa dang ji bzhin ma yin pa'i tshig 'chad shes pa'i mkhas pa/ don rnam par 'byed par nus pa'i shes rab can/ chags sdang med cing gzu bor gnas pa/ grub mtha' ngan pa'i gdon gyis blo ma bslad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis legs par gzigs la/ nged zer ba dang gzhan 'dod pa gnyis gang bden dpyad par zhu/ nges don gyi lung dang mi 'gal na/ drang don gyi lung dang 'gal yang mi skyon/ dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rigs pa dang mi 'gal na/ rigs pa ltar snang dang 'gal yang mi skyon/ rang gis mkhas blangs pa'i grub mtha' dang mi 'gal na/ gzhan gyis khas blangs pa'i grub mtha' dang 'gal yang mi skyon/ de'i rigs can thams cad mkhyen par byas la thugs kyis dpyad de dgongs par zhu/ ma dpyad par ri bong gi chal bzhin g.yam rgyugs su/ bden mi bden gyi dbye ba byas na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i babs la gnod pa dang*/ rang la sdig pa'i khur lci zhing mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhad gad du 'gyur bar go dper na rgyal po'i bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs na/ yul brlag par 'gyur na/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs na/

'jig rten brlag par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ de'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba la 'bad dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzhin gsungs na bla ma/ de'i gsung bzhin bsgrubs na slob ma/ de dag gi mthun pa'i yo byad bsgrubs na yon bdag de lta bu gang na yod pa de na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yod par shes par bya'o// 'phrin 'di sangs rgyas bstan pa la// mos pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa dang*// blo gros ldan pa'i mkhas rnams dang*// skye bo dam pa rnams la spring*// gal te bdag gi tshig bden na// dam pa rnams kyis legs zhes gsungs// 'on te 'di la skyon chags na// lung dang rigs pas sun phyung shig /gal te bdag gi bden bzhin du// blun po thams cad kha 'dus nas// bdag la skur pa 'debs pa na// dam pa rnams kyis dgongs su gsol// blun po rnams kyis dug zos nas// sman pa mkhas la khro ba ltar// blun po chos log spyod pa yis// mkhas la khro ba 'di re mtshar// des na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// bstan pa phyi dro'i nyi ma 'dra// skye bo ngan pa'i 'ug pa dag /mgo bo bteg nas hung sgra 'byin// mkhas dang mkhas pa bsten pa'i sgrub ba po// sangs rgyas bstan la gces par gang 'dzin pa// de dag kun la bdag gis 'phrin 'di spring*// gzung bor gnas pa'i yid kyis legs par dpyod// sde snod 'dzin pa sa skya paṇḍi tas skyes bu dam pa rnams la 'phrin du phul ba 'di re zhig rdzogs so/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
